entries.title: Psalms 139:1
segments: ¶<<For the Chief Musician. A Psalm of David.>> O LORD, You have searched me and known [me].

entries.title: Psalms 139:2
segments: You know my sitting down and my rising up; You understand my thought afar off.

entries.title: Psalms 139:3
segments: You comprehend my path and my lying down, And are acquainted with all my ways.

entries.title: Psalms 139:4
segments: For [there is] not a word on my tongue, [But] behold, O LORD, You know it altogether.

entries.title: Psalms 139:5
segments: You have hedged me behind and before, And laid Your hand upon me.

entries.title: Psalms 139:6
segments: [Such] knowledge [is] too wonderful for me; It is high, I cannot [attain] it.

entries.title: Psalms 139:7
segments: ¶Where can I go from Your Spirit? Or where can I flee from Your presence?

entries.title: Psalms 139:8
segments: If I ascend into heaven, You [are] there; If I make my bed in hell, behold, You [are there].

entries.title: Psalms 139:9
segments: [If] I take the wings of the morning, [And] dwell in the uttermost parts of the sea,

entries.title: Psalms 139:10
segments: Even there Your hand shall lead me, And Your right hand shall hold me.

entries.title: Psalms 139:11
segments: If I say, "Surely the darkness shall fall on me," Even the night shall be light about me;

entries.title: Psalms 139:12
segments: Indeed, the darkness shall not hide from You, But the night shines as the day; The darkness and the light [are] both alike [to You].

entries.title: Psalms 139:13
segments: For You formed my inward parts; You covered me in my mother's womb.

entries.title: Psalms 139:14
segments: I will praise You, for I am fearfully [and] wonderfully made; Marvelous are Your works, And [that] my soul knows very well.

entries.title: Psalms 139:15
segments: My frame was not hidden from You, When I was made in secret, [And] skillfully wrought in the lowest parts of the earth.

entries.title: Psalms 139:16
segments: Your eyes saw my substance, being yet unformed. And in Your book they all were written, The days fashioned for me, When [as yet there were] none of them.

entries.title: Psalms 139:17
segments: ¶How precious also are Your thoughts to me, O God! How great is the sum of them!

entries.title: Psalms 139:18
segments: [If] I should count them, they would be more in number than the sand; When I awake, I am still with You.

entries.title: Psalms 139:19
segments: Oh, that You would slay the wicked, O God! Depart from me, therefore, you bloodthirsty men.

entries.title: Psalms 139:20
segments: For they speak against You wickedly; Your enemies take [Your name] in vain.

entries.title: Psalms 139:21
segments: Do I not hate them, O LORD, who hate You? And do I not loathe those who rise up against You?

entries.title: Psalms 139:22
segments: I hate them with perfect hatred; I count them my enemies.

entries.title: Psalms 139:23
segments: Search me, O God, and know my heart; Try me, and know my anxieties;

entries.title: Psalms 139:24
segments: And see if [there is any] wicked way in me, And lead me in the way everlasting.
